node -e "console.log('SmartSpace Development Commands

Playwright Testing:

scripts.client:dev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File update_ip.ps1 && cd smartspace_client && flutter run --web-port=9090
scripts.admin:dev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File update_ip.ps1 && cd smartspace_admin && flutter run --web-port=9090
scripts.staff:dev: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File update_ip.ps1 && cd smartspace_staff && flutter run --web-port=9090
scripts.flutter:get: cd smartspace_admin && flutter pub get && cd ../smartspace_client && flutter pub get && cd ../smartspace_staff && flutter pub get && cd ../mobile_shared && flutter pub get
scripts.flutter:clean: cd smartspace_admin && flutter clean && cd ../smartspace_client && flutter clean && cd ../smartspace_staff && flutter clean && cd ../mobile_shared && flutter clean
scripts.build:release: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File update_ip.ps1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File buildApkRelease.ps1
scripts.build:debug: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File update_ip.ps1 && npm run client:build:debug && npm run admin:build:debug && npm run staff:build:debug
